name: hatch
description: Drive Hatch, the browser on this Mac whose live pages the user watches, from any project.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the browser the user watches.
interface.longDescription: Hatch is a macOS browser built for agents. Its live pages sit as frames on a canvas the user watches, so the user sees every page the agent opens and every click it makes. With this plugin Codex reads a page as an outline with a reference on every line, acts by reference, opens local projects at hatch:<name>, reads comments the user pinned, and fills saved sign-ins after the user agrees.
